name: Youer
author: 61485115+keimag-dev@users.noreply.github.com
description: Generic Youer (NeoForge + Paper/Purpur hybrid) on Java 21. Verified SHA-256 downloads, exact version/build selection, safe reinstall and explicit EULA consent. No modpack included.

variables.name: Minecraft Version
variables.description: Install/reinstall: explicit official Minecraft version; no fallback. Java 21 verified with 1.21.1.

variables.name: Youer Build
variables.description: Install/reinstall: latest selects highest advertised build for this Minecraft version; numeric pins exactly. Missing builds fail.

variables.name: Server Jar File
variables.description: Install and start: safe JAR basename. Changing this requires reinstall; only the selected JAR is replaced.

variables.name: Server Name
variables.description: First install only: server-name property (not displayed by all Minecraft clients). Existing server.properties is never replaced.

variables.name: Message of the Day
variables.description: First install only: server-list MOTD. No line breaks; edit server.properties after installation.

variables.name: Maximum Players
variables.description: First install only: max-players; edit server.properties for an existing server.

variables.name: Game Mode
variables.description: First install only: default mode for new players.

variables.name: Online Mode
variables.description: First install only: authenticate with Mojang/Microsoft. Keep true unless intentionally using a secured proxy configuration.

variables.name: Whitelist Enabled
variables.description: First install only: toggles white-list; never adds identities or replaces whitelist.json.

variables.name: View Distance
variables.description: First install only: chunk radius (2..32). Larger values increase memory and CPU needs.

variables.name: World Name
variables.description: First install only: safe world directory basename. Reinstall does not rename, delete, or replace worlds.

variables.name: Maximum Java Heap -Xmx (MiB)
variables.description: Every start: 0 = allocation minus native headroom. Explicit 512+ must fit that budget. With unlimited allocation, 0 uses Unlimited Heap.

variables.name: Initial Java Heap -Xms (MiB)
variables.description: Every start: initial heap (default 128); 16+ and no greater than the effective maximum Java heap (-Xmx).

variables.name: Garbage Collector
variables.description: Every start: default (recommended) preserves JVM ergonomics. Optional g1, zgc, zgc-generational (Java 21), parallel or serial. No performance guarantee; use this field, not extra collector flags.

variables.name: Extra JVM Arguments
variables.description: Every start: optional space-separated JVM tuning (max 4096 characters). Quotes/backslash group arguments; no shell expansion. Heap/GC must use dedicated fields; no entrypoint, classpath, @argfile or JVM option-file overrides. See README.

variables.name: Native Memory Headroom (MiB)
variables.description: Every start: reserve outside Java heap for metaspace, threads and native buffers (minimum 256, default 1024). Not an OS memory limit.

variables.name: Unlimited Allocation Heap (MiB)
variables.description: Every start: bounded heap when SERVER_MEMORY=0 and Java Heap=0; default 4096. Size the host/container separately.
